rules_description: Agronomic validation constraints for intercropping systems based on ICAR and state agricultural university guidelines.

maturity_gap.fail_reason: Maturity gap is too large ({maturity_gap} days). One crop will mature long before the other, causing severe harvest damage or premature abandonment of the field.
maturity_gap.warning_reason: Maturity gap is {maturity_gap} days. Synchronized spraying and harvesting operations will require extra care.

incompatible_pairs.fail_reason: Severe shading conflict: {crop_a} ({height_a} cm, {canopy_a}) will smother {crop_b} ({height_b} cm, {canopy_b}), denying photosynthetic radiation to the lower canopy.
Excessive height disparity ({height_diff} cm) will create asymmetric solar competition between companion varieties.

root_system_competition.conflict_rule: Identical root architecture at the same shallow depth induces severe below-ground competition for moisture and phosphate.
root_system_competition.ideal_pairing: Complementary root zones (e.g., Fibrous shallow with Taproot deep).

incompatible_levels.fail_reason: Incompatible water needs: {crop_a} requires high irrigation, which will cause root rot or waterlogging stress in {crop_b}.

warning_levels.warning_reason: Moderate water differential; careful furrow scheduling recommended.

soil_ph.fail_reason: Soil pH ranges do not overlap. {crop_a} requires pH {ph_min_a}-{ph_max_a} while {crop_b} requires pH {ph_min_b}-{ph_max_b}.

nutrient_synergy.description: Legume biological nitrogen fixation benefits companion cereals and post-harvest soil microbial health.
